Transcription.// Notes: Per Voice Live 2025-10-01 spec, only these models are supported with gpt-realtime: whisper-1, gpt-4o-transcribe, gpt-4o-mini-transcribe, gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize. azure-speech is NOT supported with gpt-realtime. Default whisper-1 is the safest choice for short Danish phone-call utterances; gpt-4o-transcribe has lower WER on long-form benchmarks but documented truncation issues on short audio (Oct 2025+). The transcript is a separate async pass and may diverge from what the model actually heard.
